mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, dict_name, dict_type, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_type WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM sys_dict_type
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT FROM sys_dict_type
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_type (id, tenant_id, dict_name, dict_type, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{dictName}, #{dictType}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_type SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_type WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id = '0') ORDER BY dict_type ASC
